tableSelection.title: Choose a table to practice
tableSelection.description: Pick any table that is ready. Locked tables stay visible so a child can see what opens up next.

testSection.title: 20 random questions across unlocked tables
testSection.description: Questions are mixed automatically and the result is shown at the end of the session.

settingsScreen.title: Practice profile
settingsScreen.description: Choose how each table session should ask its questions.
settingsScreen.questionOrderDescription: Set whether questions follow the multiplication table or appear in a shuffled order.
settingsScreen.inOrderDescription: Questions stay in the table sequence from start to finish.
settingsScreen.randomizedDescription: Questions are shuffled within the table for extra variety.
settingsScreen.hesitationRuleDescription: Show a 5-second timer when answering; if time runs out, reset question

tableCard.rewardsNeededMessage: You need {{rewardsNeeded}} more rewards to unlock this table

header.title: Practice the {{table}} times table
header.defaultDescription: Solve each question one by one. Keep going until all 10 are done.

rewardEarned.title: You earned 1 reward
rewardEarned.description: Strong first-try work adds to the child's running collection.

sessionSummary.title: Session summary
sessionSummary.description: Great work. You answered {{correctAnswerCount}} out of {{totalQuestionCount}} questions correctly.

practiceHistory.title: Past sessions
practiceHistory.emptyMessage: Your practice history will appear here, once you completed your first practice session.
